jobs.name: Prioritize Projects
jobs.purpose: Produce an ordered list of active company priorities from authored Projects and locked Mission/Business Model rules, so Marketing and Operations execute against founder strategy rather than inventing it.
jobs.trigger: Founder request; weekly Executive review; a new Project is authored; or a material blocker changes active Project status (e.g. deploy blocked, domain gap).
jobs.inputs:
- Active Project notes under 03 Projects/
- Current company priorities (if any)
- Known blockers recorded in Project notes
- Any open founder decisions affecting priority
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Mission]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Vision]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Business Model]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- [[06 Registry/Project Registry]]
- Active Project notes (Landing Page; Pre-Launch Go-to-Market)
jobs.preconditions:
- Mission and Business Model Knowledge are present.
- Project Registry lists the authored Projects (or Project notes are readable).
- No invented Projects — only authored Project inputs.
jobs.execution:
1. Load Mission (organize discovery — LOCKED; content-first is GTM strategy only) and Business Model (independent-first; one gates-open launch — LOCKED).
2. Load every authored active Project from the Project Registry / 03 Projects and record each project's objective, status, next_action, and blockers verbatim.
3. Rank Projects by: (a) mission alignment (discovery), (b) whether the Project unblocks waitlist acquisition (content → landing → waitlist under GTM content-first), (c) whether a recorded blocker prevents progress, (d) independent-first path (partnerships do not outrank independent work).
4. Write an ordered priority list with one owner System per priority (Executive decides direction; Marketing owns content/demand; Operations owns routing — never assign Product/Engineering/Analytics work that has no authored System Job yet).
5. Name the single top priority that Marketing Content Planning must consume next.
6. Record deferred items explicitly; do not silently drop them.
7. Update the Executive Control Center / Company Priorities reflection and hand the priority list to Marketing for Plan and Produce Campaign.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF a Project status or blocker is absent from source, THEN mark `NOT IN SOURCE — needs founder` and do not invent status.
- IF two Projects conflict for capacity, THEN rank by mission (discovery) and GTM waitlist acquisition (content-first) over secondary initiatives; ESCALATE WHEN the founder must break the tie.
- IF a partnership or deal would displace independent waitlist/content work, THEN keep independent-first ranking (Business Model LOCKED) and note the deal as accelerant, not dependency.
- IF the top priority is blocked only by an external gap (e.g. sending domain), THEN keep it ranked but flag the blocker; do not pretend the Project is complete.
- ESCALATE WHEN priority would change locked founder directives or require a new Business System.
jobs.outputs: An ordered company priority list: ranked Projects, top priority for Marketing Content Planning, deferred items, and explicit blockers.
jobs.destinations: Executive 03 Company Priorities; Marketing (next Job: Plan and Produce Campaign); Operations only if routing/activation is required; Project notes remain canonical for each Project's own status.
jobs.updates: Executive Control Center priority reflection; handoff note that Content Planning may begin against the top priority.
jobs.validation:
- Every listed Project exists in authored Project inputs
- Mission and independent-first rules cited
- Top priority named for Marketing
- Blockers quoted from source, not invented
- No department execution performed by Executive
jobs.approval: Founder approval required to adopt or change the ordered company priority list (resource-allocation / strategic attention per Approval Rules). Draft ranking may be prepared without approval; publishing the list as company priority requires founder approval.
jobs.exceptions: If Project Registry or Project notes are unreadable, stop and record the missing source. If Mission/Business Model conflict with a requested priority, surface the conflict — do not override locked Knowledge.

permissions.allowed_reads: Company Brain Mission/Vision/Business Model/Founder Directives; Project Registry; authored Project notes; Executive Control Center.
permissions.allowed_writes: Executive priority artifacts and Control Center reflections inside the generated OS / canonical Executive destinations only.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Creating marketing assets or posting content
- Changing Project source status without founder instruction
- Inventing Projects or metrics
- Expanding agent authority
- Production/database writes

jobs.completion_condition: An ordered priority list exists, the top priority for Content Planning is named, blockers are explicit, and founder approval to adopt the list is recorded or explicitly requested.
jobs.improvement_loop: When the founder reorders priorities or corrects a ranking rationale, fold the correction into this Job's decision_logic via recorded improvement — do not keep the correction only in chat.
jobs.escalate_when: Priority change would violate a locked directive, create a new Business System, or require spending/domain decisions not in source.

jobs.name: Prepare Founder Brief
jobs.purpose: Assemble the Executive brief for the acquisition loop: priorities, content/publish status, demand routing, waitlist funnel numbers, blockers, and next actions — so the founder can review and improve from evidence.
jobs.trigger: Scheduled Executive review; after Funnel and Demand Report; or founder request for a loop brief.
jobs.inputs:
- Priority list from Prioritize Projects
- Content plan / draft / approval / publish handoff statuses
- Demand-routing records
- Funnel report / Qualified Demand Generated
- Known blockers (domain, deploy, UTM)
- Open improvements
jobs.required_sources:
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Mission]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Business Model]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Company/Founder Directives]]
- [[04 Knowledge/Integrations/Integration Brain]]
- [[06 Registry/Project Registry]]
- Outputs of: Prioritize Projects; Plan and Produce Campaign; Produce Content; Route Publishing Approval; Publish Approved Content; Generate Qualified Demand; Funnel and Demand Report; Capture Marketing Improvement
- Projects: Pre-Launch Go-to-Market; Landing Page (Waitlist Website)
jobs.preconditions:
- Mission Knowledge present.
- At least Project Registry or Project notes readable.
- Numbers only from sourced funnel extract — never invented.
jobs.execution:
1. Summarize current top priority and whether GTM remains the Marketing focus.
2. Report content pipeline state: plan → drafts → approvals → publish handoffs (counts and blockers).
3. Report demand routing and Lead Capture external status (waitlist live vs landing deploy blocked).
4. Report Qualified Demand Generated (stage-level signups) or mark `NOT IN SOURCE` if extract missing; never invent per-platform splits.
5. List Heat-level blockers verbatim from Integration Brain / Projects (sending domain, deploy, UTM).
6. List recommended next actions with owning System (Executive / Marketing / external founder action).
7. Hand open learnings to Capture Marketing Improvement when corrections are required.
8. Do not perform Marketing execution inside this Job.
jobs.decision_logic:
- IF a metric target is `NOT IN SOURCE`, THEN report the raw number without green/red status invention.
- IF landing deploy is blocked, THEN state acquisition loop is definitionally operable in SVOS but publicly incomplete until domain/deploy.
- IF publish handoffs are blocked on email domain, THEN separate social vs email channels in the brief.
- ESCALATE WHEN the brief would require a new Business System or kernel change to resolve a blocker.
jobs.outputs: A Founder Brief covering priority, loop status, funnel numbers, blockers, and next actions.
jobs.destinations: Executive 09 Executive Reviews / Control Center brief slot; founder; Capture Marketing Improvement when actions require it.
jobs.updates: Executive review artifacts; optional GTM Project next_action reflection.
jobs.validation:
- Every number sourced or marked `NOT IN SOURCE`
- Blockers quoted from canonical Project/Integration sources
- Next actions have owners
- No Marketing assets created here
jobs.approval: Brief preparation does not require approval. Decisions arising from the brief follow Approve Strategic Decision / Record Founder Decision as applicable.
jobs.exceptions: If funnel extract is unavailable, ship the brief with explicit `NOT IN SOURCE` for counts. If loop Job outputs are missing, note which stages are not yet run.

permissions.allowed_reads: Company Brain; Project notes; Marketing/Executive loop outputs; funnel extract via approved path.
permissions.prohibited_actions:
- Inventing metrics
- Publishing content
- Database writes
- Expanding permissions

jobs.completion_condition: Founder Brief exists with priority, loop status, sourced (or NOT IN SOURCE) demand numbers, blockers, and owned next actions.
jobs.improvement_loop: Founder edits to brief structure update this Job; recurring missing fields become preconditions.
jobs.escalate_when: Brief implies architecture change or new System as the only fix.
